quests.title: Dwarkanath's White Iron Chunks

dialogue.t: Ah, I remember. Iradj's always losing my knives so I posted the commission.
I guess you've got those five White Iron Chunks?

dialogue.sit: Here are the White Iron Chunks you wanted.

dialogue.t: Thank you, I will go to dad later to make a bunch of knives. Can't wait to see Iradj's face when he gets them, haha!

quests.description: Dwarkanath from Sumeru City needs five White Iron Chunks.
